summary: Separate English and Vietnamese first-party discovery was completed. Official Lâm Đồng land-data and land-registration custody is evidenced, and the current national viewer configuration exposes cadastral routes and field metadata, but no safe anonymous native parcel ID plus complete polygon response was verified for Đà Lạt. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Exact query text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-6197-l-t.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET checks retrieved the national viewer, public configuration, public-region payload, official Lâm Đồng Đà Lạt land-status page, and official legal publication. Authenticated config returned 401; anonymous config returned 404; two official planning portals had expired certificates and were not accessed with verification disabled. The current JavaScript exposed /api/dia-chinh/features, but it was not called because safe request parameters and safe response fields were not established. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
attemptedRoutes: See city-6197-l-t.json requestOutcomes for every route and outcome.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no parcel endpoint was available for an exact-point request.
Provincial/national custodian evidence is not proof of a public local Đà Lạt parcel API.
Login wall, 404 route, expired certificate, and lack of an exact-point query do not prove citywide cadastral absence.
No stable native parcel ID, safe parcel schema, CRS, or full parcel polygon was retrieved.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native parcel geometry response was available.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Lâm Đồng land-data/registration custody and the national Vietnam land-data viewer, with Đà Lạt land-use/status publications.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official land-data and procedural publications plus public viewer configuration only; no Đà Lạt local or citywide parcel geometry scope.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: Local Đà Lạt service ownership, public access model, safe parcel identity semantics, geometry delivery, CRS, and city-boundary coverage remain unresolved. No claim is made about parcel absence or legal title.
